domain: Technology History / Industrial Standards / Path Dependence
topic_summary: Analysis of QWERTY keyboard layout persistence as a contested kernel where one reading treats it as neutral path-dependent artifact (alternatives lapsed without antagonism) and another treats it as beneficiary-preserved incumbency (manufacturers/typists actively maintained dominance). The topic tests whether kernel structure reproduces D3 ARTIFACT (beneficiary-hunting finds beneficiaries by construction) or reveals genuine structural difference.

key_entities: QWERTY layout (1873 Sholes & Glidden typewriter standard)
Touch-typing training infrastructure (schools, corporate training, standardized curricula)
Early adopter typists (developed muscle memory on QWERTY 1880s-1920s)
key_tensions: Alleged efficiency advantage (Dvorak claims 20-40% speed increase) vs empirical performance studies (1956 GSA study found minimal advantage)
Network effects explanation (coordination value of shared standard) vs lock-in explanation (switching costs preserve inferior standard)

axes.structural_delta: QWERTY persists because alternatives never achieved sufficient adoption to trigger coordination cascade, not because anyone defended it
axes.primary_observable: Absence of documented suppression campaigns; presence of multiple failed alternative launches with low adoption
axes.selection_reason: First reading of contested kernel; tests whether coordination-only story generates different constraint structure

axes.structural_delta: QWERTY persists because manufacturers, training institutions, and skilled typists benefit from preventing alternatives that would devalue their capital
axes.primary_observable: Evidence of active resistance to alternatives; asymmetric marketing/training investment; documented suppression attempts
axes.selection_reason: Second reading of contested kernel; tests whether adding beneficiary structure changes constraint type from rope to tangled_rope

axes.structural_delta: QWERTY naturalized via efficiency claims (jam prevention, optimal finger travel) that are post-hoc rationalizations rather than design intent
axes.primary_observable: Historical design documents vs retrospective efficiency claims; experimental ergonomics data
axes.selection_reason: Deferred: scaffold feeding into both readings but not structurally distinct enough for independent generation

axes.structural_delta: Cost to retrain existing typists vastly exceeds benefit from marginal efficiency gains, even if alternatives are objectively superior
axes.primary_observable: Retraining time studies; productivity loss during transition; institutional training investment
axes.selection_reason: Mountain base affecting both readings; tests whether switching costs are neutral constraint or benefit-preserving mechanism

deferred_axes.structural_delta: Efficiency claims are post-hoc naturalizations rather than design intent
deferred_axes.deferral_reason: Feeds into both readings but lacks independent structural yield; captured via naturalization claims within each reading

omegas.description: Does the beneficiary-reading emit genuinely different constraint structure (type/epsilon/victim-set) than the lapsed-alternatives reading, or does D3 ARTIFACT hold—beneficiary-hunting finds beneficiaries by construction without changing the structural analysis? If both readings produce rope-type constraints with identical switching-cost observables, the kernel is not contested and should collapse.
omegas.source: Kernel contest declaration + D3 ARTIFACT warning

omegas.description: Is QWERTY objectively less efficient than Dvorak? 1956 GSA study found minimal difference; later studies contest this. If no measurable efficiency gap exists, both readings collapse to pure coordination story (rope without victim set).
omegas.source: Extraction tension on alleged efficiency advantage + F03 gate

omegas.description: Is there documentary evidence of active suppression (manufacturers blocking Dvorak typewriters, training institutions refusing to teach alternatives)? Incumbent-preservation reading requires affirmative evidence; absence would collapse it to lapsed-alternatives.
omegas.source: Primary observable for incumbent_preservation_reading + F34 domain competence limit

omegas.description: Did the 1888 touch-typing standardization create the lock-in, or was QWERTY already entrenched? If touch-typing is the mechanism, it's a mountain (training infrastructure) not a tangled_rope (beneficiary defense).
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 2 (Absence Inventory) on training infrastructure timing

fracture_scan.notes: F03: efficiency_mythology classified as scaffold but historical design intent claims may exceed available evidence. F34: Domain competence limited on 19th-century typewriter industry suppression tactics; empirical ergonomics contested. Generated omegas for D3 artifact test, efficiency claims, and suppression evidence.

commitment_system_recognition.kernel_description: QWERTY keyboard layout persistence as either neutral coordination equilibrium or beneficiary-defended incumbency
commitment_system_recognition.authority_description: Historical narrative authority—whether QWERTY story is framed as path-dependent accident or strategic lock-in

readings.commitment: Standards persist via coordination value; alternatives lapse when adoption fails to reach critical mass
readings.expected_structural_delta: Rope constraint (coordination requirement) with no beneficiary set; epsilon determined by switching costs alone; victim set empty or symmetric (all parties bear coordination costs equally)

readings.commitment: Standards persist via beneficiary defense; incumbents actively preserve dominance to protect capital investments
readings.expected_structural_delta: Tangled_rope constraint (coordination + extraction) with defined beneficiary set (manufacturers, trained typists, training institutions); epsilon includes defensive suppression costs; victim set includes alternative-adopters and efficiency-seekers

axiom_contradictions.basis: One treats persistence as neutral outcome of coordination failure (no agent defends the standard); the other treats persistence as defended outcome of beneficiary action (agents actively suppress alternatives). No single framework can hold both: either suppression happened (beneficiary reading) or it didn't (lapsed-alternatives reading). The presence/absence of beneficiary defense is empirically decidable, not interpretive.
